create_adapter_config_default: create an AdapterConfig instance with default values for adapter tuning in a pretrained model
configure_adapter_nonlinearity: configure the AdapterConfig nonlinearity to use gelu_new activation for adapter layers
set_adapter_reduction_factor: set the AdapterConfig reduction factor to control the bottleneck dimension of adapters
enable_adapter_tuning: enable adapter tuning by setting adapter_tune to true in AdapterConfig
configure_adapter_placement: configure AdapterConfig to add adapters after attention and feedforward layers
